title: 第7586章 神秘人身份第7585章 最终碰面
slug: 万古第一神第7596章第三轮
content_zh:
而这时候，本就备受关注的‘五好少年’队伍，也因为姬银妍的现身而吸引了更多目光。
整个烽墟各处，抬头看着影像图的民众们议论纷纷。
“没想到小公主他们，先是跟渊亲王之子相遇，现在又是跟渊亲王之女相遇……”
“他们皇室两家人，这是杠上了？”
“不过，这银妍郡主身边的队友都是什么来历，怎么如此神秘，连脸都不露？”
看见这四个黑影，很多人好奇不已。
毕竟，哪怕是如织妄永恒帝国等等三级星系加盟国，在暗中安排参加万宗帝战时，都得展露真实样貌，而这几人却敢隐藏身份。
这种情况在万宗帝战中非常少见，但在场的姬玄鉴和姬银妍两个皇室成员，却似乎并不觉得奇怪。
她们似乎都知道一些大多数人都不知道的事，才能如此淡定。
而这一幕，也更加地耐人寻味，让人们纷纷猜测。
同时，也有很多人相互之间打听了这支队伍此前的表现。
“有谁关注了‘银妍郡主’的这支队伍？谁知道这几个到底是何方神圣？”
街道当中，这问声一发出，便有人热心回应。
“我一直在看这银妍郡主的影像图，但是她这几个队友却基本都不出手，甚至哪怕有对手了，也是银妍郡主在出手，其余人袖手旁观……似乎，他们根本就不在乎谁被淘汰！”
“这就怪了，如果是请来的帮手的话，又怎么可能让银妍郡主亲自操劳呢？”有人困惑道。
“不仅如此，这四个人甚至在这九百年都没去收获任何的帝分，没收任何的宝物，就只是静静跟着银妍郡主而已。”那观察着姬银妍队伍的民众又接着说道。
这种情况，更加地令人不解。
与此同时，万宗战殿之中亦是议论纷纷，无数来自外疆的人们都看着李天命等人的身影。
但奇怪的是，这偌大一个万宗战殿，哪怕有着无数长辈在此，却都对姬银妍四个队友的身份说不出个所以然来。
哪怕有些长辈的资历已经很老，带了很多届的弟子来参战，也对这种情况几乎一无所知。

风月幽薇此刻立侍于千幻令仪身边，她红唇轻启好奇问道，“令仪姐姐，这几人的来历，您可曾了解？”
“不知。”千幻令仪缓缓摇了摇头。
“连您也不知？”风月幽薇红唇微张有些诧异。
“嗯。”千幻令仪微微点头，而后目光又看向了一旁的玄天阙，语气有些恭敬道，“巡察使大人，您可知对方来历？”
虽然她对李天命以及李氏天帝宗都算是恨得牙痒痒，但却不会把恩怨放在巡察使的身上，否则便是自讨苦吃。
这一点，她还是很看得清。
然而玄天阙闻言却是微微皱了皱眉。
他想了半天，最终也是摇头道，“我也没听说过这样一群人，更没见过万宗帝战里有人能这样出现，或许，这都是陛下的特殊安排吧……”
如今这一幕，也只能这么解释，否则姬银妍这种明明被拥在中间，遇事却只有自己动手的情况还真的不好解释。
content_en:
At this time, the 'Five Good Boys' team, which was already attracting much attention, also attracted more attention because of Ji Yinyan's appearance.
Throughout the Fengxu Ruins, people who looked up at the image were talking about it.
"I didn't expect that the little princess and the others would first meet Prince Yuan's son, and now they would meet Prince Yuan's daughter..."
"Is there a conflict between the two royal families?"
"However, what are the origins of the teammates around Princess Yinyan, and why are they so mysterious that they don't even show their faces?"
Seeing these four black figures, many people were curious.
After all, even third-level galaxy alliance countries such as Zhiwang Eternal Empire and other third-level galaxy alliances have to show their true appearance when secretly arranging to participate in the Wan Zong Emperor War, but these people dare to hide their identities.
This situation is very rare in the Wan Zong Emperor War, but the two royal family members Ji Xuanjian and Ji Yinyan present did not seem to find it strange.
They all seem to know something that most people don't know, so they can be so calm.
And this scene is even more intriguing and makes people speculate.
At the same time, many people also asked each other about the previous performance of this team.
"Has anyone paid attention to the team of 'Princess Yinyan'? Who knows who these people are?"
In the streets, as soon as this question was raised, someone responded enthusiastically.
"I have been looking at the images of Princess Yinyan, but her teammates basically don't take action. Even if there is an opponent, it is Princess Yinyan who takes action, while the others stand by and watch... It seems that they don't care who is eliminated at all!"
"That's strange. If it's a helper invited, how can Princess Yinyan do the work herself?" someone asked in confusion.
"Not only that, these four people have not even harvested any imperial points or confiscated any treasures in these nine hundred years. They just followed Princess Yinyan quietly." The people who were observing Ji Yinyan's team continued.
This situation is even more puzzling.
At the same time, there was also a lot of discussion in the Wanzong War Hall, and countless people from outside the border looked at the figures of Li Tianming and others.
But the strange thing is that even though there are countless elders in this huge Ten Thousand Sects War Hall, none of them can explain the identities of Ji Yinyan's four teammates.
Even if some elders are very senior and have brought many disciples to participate in the war, they have almost no idea about this situation.
Feng Yue Youwei was standing next to Qian Huan Ling Yi. She lightly opened her red lips and asked curiously, "Sister Ling Yi, do you know the origins of these people?"
"I don't know." Qian Huan Lingyi slowly shook his head.
"You don't even know?" Fengyue Youwei's red lips parted slightly in surprise.
"Yes." Qian Huan Lingyi nodded slightly, then looked at Xuan Tianque aside, and said in a somewhat respectful tone, "Master Inspector, do you know the origin of this person?"
Although she hated Li Tianming and the Li Tiandi Sect with a passion, she would not put her grudges on the inspectors, otherwise she would be asking for trouble.
She could still see this clearly.
However, Xuan Tianque frowned slightly when he heard this.
He thought for a long time, and finally shook his head and said, "I have never heard of such a group of people, and I have never seen anyone appear like this in the Ten Thousand Sects Emperor War. Perhaps this is your Majesty's special arrangement..."
Now this scene can only be explained in this way, otherwise it is really difficult to explain the situation where Ji Yinyan is clearly surrounded by others, but she has to do it herself when something happens.
